slots.purpose: Hero: signals Turkish wedding customs at a glance and reads as luxury editorial.
slots.shot_brief: Real wedding with Turkish roots, evening reception or kına gecesi: wide frame of guests in a halay line or the couple under warm string light, faces soft or turned. Couple consent on file, no identifiable children, no flags of any political group, no venue signage. Landscape 16:9 with room for a title overlay.
slots.fit_reason: Licensed real-wedding photo with couple consent (library, commissioned or licensed stock). Never AI, never from a competitor or the old page.

slots.purpose: Lets readers picture kız isteme, where the bride-to-be serves Turkish coffee to the visiting family.
slots.shot_brief: Close still life: Turkish coffee in small porcelain cups with saucers on a brass or engraved tray, a glass of water and lokum beside it, soft window light, linen or wood surface. No people, no hands, no place markers. Landscape 3:2.
slots.fit_reason: Option (needs Nic's approval first): AI-generated neutral still life with no people, dress, ceremony or place, captioned 'Illustrative image'. Otherwise a licensed stock or commissioned still life.

slots.purpose: Shows the warmth of the kına gecesi so the henna night section feels real.
slots.shot_brief: Real kına gecesi: henna bowl with candles carried by guests, warm candlelight, red tones; bride's hands with henna in a cloth or the circle of guests from behind. Real event only, consent on file, no identifiable children. Landscape or 4:5.
slots.fit_reason: Licensed real-wedding photo with couple consent (library, commissioned or licensed stock). Never AI, never from a competitor or the old page. Cultural dress and ceremony rule out AI.

slots.purpose: Shows the bindallı dress (velvet with gold embroidery) worn at the henna night.
slots.shot_brief: Real bindallı: detail of deep red or purple velvet with gold embroidery, worn at a real kına gecesi or a museum-held garment photographed with the museum's licence. Detail crop acceptable, no face needed. Portrait 4:5.
slots.fit_reason: Licensed real-wedding photo with couple consent (library, commissioned or licensed stock). Never AI, never from a competitor or the old page. A museum collection image is acceptable only with written licence. Cultural dress rules out AI.

slots.purpose: Carries the sound and movement of the day: davul and zurna players and the halay line.
slots.shot_brief: Real wedding: davul and zurna players leading guests, or the halay line with linked little fingers and the lead dancer's handkerchief, motion blur welcome, daylight or evening. Consent on file, no identifiable children. Landscape 3:2.
slots.fit_reason: Licensed real-wedding photo with couple consent (library, commissioned or licensed stock). Never AI, never from a competitor or the old page. People and ceremony rule out AI.

slots.purpose: Illustrates takı töreni, gold gifts pinned or given to the couple, without showing amounts.
slots.shot_brief: Preferred: real takı töreni with gold pinned on a red sash, framed so no amount or value is readable, consent on file. Fallback: close still life of a few gold coins and a red ribbon on dark velvet, no people, no currency text or denominations legible.
slots.fit_reason: Real event photo needs couple consent. Fallback option (needs Nic's approval first): AI-generated neutral still life with no people, dress, ceremony or place, captioned 'Illustrative image'. Otherwise a licensed stock or commissioned still life.

slots.purpose: Grounds the legal and destination section for Australians marrying in Türkiye.
slots.shot_brief: Licensed landscape of a destination outside Smartraveller's higher-level areas (not within 10km of the Syrian border, not Hakkari or Şırnak), e.g. an Aegean or Istanbul view, soft morning light, no people or with tiny distant figures, no venue branding. Location must be verified (EXIF, register or source page). Landscape 16:9.
slots.fit_reason: Licensed stock or own-site photo with verified location. A real place, so never AI.
